name: ashby-mcp
description: Ashby (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_ashby_job_board_name.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ASHBY_JOB_BOARD_NAME
platform_mcp_ashby_job_board_name.description: The organisation's Ashby jobs page name: the last path segment of its hosted board, e.g. 'Ashby' in https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Ashby.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Public Job Postings API for ONE organisation's board (config job_board_name): GET https://api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/{JOB_BOARD_NAME}?includeCompensation=true 'get[s] data for all currently published Job Postings for your organization'. It has no keyword, location or paging parameters, so query/location/page/limit are not sent: every published job comes back in one response — filter client-side and do not request further pages. Live responses carry a posting id (the UUID in jobUrl) that the docs' field table omits. company is null (it is the configured organisation); department, team, isRemote, workplaceType, employmentType, secondaryLocations[], applyUrl, descriptionHtml and compensation (compensationTierSummary, summaryComponents[] with minValue/maxValue/currencyCode) are in raw.
